summary: Tested Partner Console (API Checkout) end-to-end: cookie-authed /api/partner/commerce/* endpoints, /api/v1 promotion report, and admin Promotions via_partner badge. UI page loads at /advertiser/dashboard/api-checkout for test@bigfm.dubai. Sandbox promotion + spotlight + rj_read flows and LIVE promotion/spotlight (cs_test_ Stripe URL) work. AI-RJ voice picker renders 3 personas and REAL audio preview returns a working audio_url. Admin /api/admin/marketplace/promotions returns via_partner+partner_name for API-purchased promos. TWO real bugs found: (a) SANDBOX Trivia + RJ-Read from the UI fail because the client sends start_at=now which backend rejects as invalid_time_window; and (b) portal_create_sponsorship for rj_read returns sponsorship_id=null (uses res.get('id'), but rj_sponsored_read_service._shape emits 'sponsored_read_id') — so the sandbox _sandbox_activate is called with None and the read stays in status='draft' instead of 'active'.

critical.issue: Response returns sponsorship_id=null and status='draft' in sandbox. Cause: routes/partner_portal.py ~L419 does `sid = res.get('id')` but rj_sponsored_read_service._shape returns key `sponsored_read_id` (not `id`). Effect: `_sandbox_activate(db, 'rj_read', None)` is a no-op, sponsorship stays draft, and the sponsorship_id passed to the client is unusable (frontend can't call submit/checkout/status by id). Fix: `sid = res.get('sponsored_read_id') or res.get('id')`.

Backend validates start_at must be strictly in the future ('invalid_time_window'). The UI (PartnerCheckout.jsx buyTriv/buyRjr) sends `start_at: new Date().toISOString()` i.e. NOW, which fails 400 (visible as a silent `Booking failed` toast). Either relax the service validator to allow start_at<=now (backfill to now+small buffer) or fix the frontend to send `now + 60s`. Repro confirmed: SANDBOX trivia UI click produced no pc-trivia-result-sandbox in the DOM in this run.

minor.issue: Returned audio_url (S3 presigned) rejects HEAD with 403; GET (with Range) works. Not a bug per se, but consumer docs should note only GET is supported.

ui_bugs.issue: start_at is set to `new Date().toISOString()` (now) which triggers backend 'invalid_time_window' on both the sandbox Trivia buy (button pc-trivia-buy) and Live rj_read book. Send `new Date(Date.now() + 60_000).toISOString()` instead.

integration_issues.issue: Click on pc-trivia-buy shows toast 'Booking failed / invalid_time_window'; pc-trivia-result-sandbox never appears.
UI shows green 'Activated (sandbox)' but the underlying rj_sponsored_read stays in status='draft' because sponsorship_id is null in the portal response (see backend bug above).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> child inside <option> (from dev-tool x-source spans wrapping option text) — cosmetic dev-server warning, safe to ignore in prod build.
Duplicate React key warning for NavItem — spread includes `key` — cosmetic.

action_items: Fix routes/partner_portal.py portal_create_sponsorship: for rj_read use `sid = res.get('sponsored_read_id') or res.get('id')` so sandbox activation + client bookkeeping work.

Fix PartnerCheckout.jsx: in buyTriv() and buyRjr() send `start_at: new Date(Date.now() + 60000).toISOString()` (or drop start_at and let the backend default) so backend 'invalid_time_window' guard doesn't fire on immediate submissions.
(Optional) Loosen trivia/rj_read invalid_time_window guard to accept start_at within a small past-window (e.g. 5 min) to reduce clock-skew flakes.
critical_code_review_comments: partner_portal.py L419: fragile assumption that all sponsorship services return `id` — inconsistent with rj_sponsored_read_service._shape which emits `sponsored_read_id`. Use a helper `_extract_sid(res, type)` to keep it type-aware.
PartnerCheckout.jsx: buyRjr silently swallows the /submit call failure path; wrap in try and surface the real reason. Also rjr preview UI never resets `previewUrl` when switching persona.
portal_persona_preview returns 503 on preview_failed which is fine; the client currently only checks for 'elevenlabs_api_key_missing' — generalise the error toast.

success_rate.frontend: 83% (5/6 sandbox+live flows; trivia sandbox UI fails)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes the two HIGH bugs, re-run pytest backend/tests/test_partner_console.py (all 11 should pass) and re-verify the UI: pc-trivia-result-sandbox must appear after clicking pc-trivia-buy, and pc-rj-result-sandbox in the response should map to a real rj_sponsored_read with status='active' (curl `db.rj_sponsored_reads.find_one({id: sid})`). LIVE Stripe UI must not be auto-completed — only verify checkout_url + pending status endpoints.
rca of the issue: (1) rj_read sandbox: partner_portal.portal_create_sponsorship reads `res.get('id')` from `rj.create_sponsored_read` → but rj service's `_shape()` returns `sponsored_read_id`, not `id`. So sid=None → v1._sandbox_activate(None) does nothing → doc keeps default status='draft'. (2) trivia/rj_read invalid_time_window: create_sponsorship validators require `start_at > now`. Frontend sends `new Date().toISOString()` (which is now or a few ms in the past by the time it lands) → 400.
